items.reply: I change my classification to FP: the English resource is deliberately the anchor allowlist. VerifyMessageProperties.java:153–158 removes exact source-anchor matches and reports mismatches, so translations cannot introduce the claimed javascript: anchor unless it already exists in the trusted source. Self-comparison follows that policy; requiring independent validation of source anchors extends the verifier’s intended contract. Severity remains high assuming the alleged security weakness is true, as the rubric specifies.
